rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, before 2009).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2009 as 'Coreen Krige'.
rows.Bloom: Orange blend. (Flowers blend of copper, orange and brownish tones). Double (17-25 petals), cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Disease susceptibility: disease resistant.
